scope: One row per counted work unit in workstreams/po03/metrics/work-unit-runs.jsonl.

vocabulary.OBSERVED: measured from a real command, file or tool response in the recording session
vocabulary.DERIVED: computed from observed values by a stated rule, not directly measured
vocabulary.NOT_SUPPORTED: no exposed tool or interface reports this value; the observed boundary is stated
vocabulary.NOT_APPLICABLE: the condition the column describes did not exist
vocabulary.NOT_YET: in scope and intended, but not produced yet

anti_invention_rule: A column is never filled with an estimate. If the value was not observed or derivable by a stated rule, the cell carries NOT_SUPPORTED, NOT_APPLICABLE or NOT_YET with a reason.

reported_aggregates.note: Zero units are independently accepted. Acceptance is requested, not granted, in receipts/po03/2026-08-22/independent-acceptance-request.json.

PO03-WAVE-A-U04 required one repair pass after its own local verification exposed a base-resolution defect. All other units passed their gates on the first attempt. This is a self-measured gate outcome, not independent acceptance.
Requires an independent reviewer or live field use to find defects this Wave missed. Two defects were found and fixed inside the Wave, so they are not escaped defects.
One known residual vacuous-pass path is documented in control/recovery-state.json. No false green has been observed, and absence of observation is not evidence of absence.
No unit was marked COMPLETED. Seven units are PARENT_INGESTED with real commit ids; COMPLETED was deliberately withheld because producer and coordinator were the same worker.
Median of active_time_seconds over the nine units with two real observed timestamp endpoints; the tenth unit cannot record its own end inside its own commit. Range 88 to 808 seconds.
No loss or interruption occurred, so no recovery was timed.
No subordinate dispatch occurred, so there was no inter-agent coordination cost to measure.
No tool reports admitted context bytes or token usage.
Seven recorded hypotheses each have a named executable reproduction in this repository. External-literature research was not performed; see research/hypotheses.jsonl.
Three lessons changed live mechanisms with regression tests: CI base resolution, rename detection, symlink manifest provenance.
One model family executed every unit; there is no second family's contribution to compare.
Requires two model families; none was available for review.
G0 and G1 are recorded in metrics/generation-comparison.json. G2 does not exist. G1's gates have run once in CI and passed, which yields no field failures to compile a successor from.
